scenes.broll: Close, high-angle view of two women's hands making a salad together in a wide white ceramic bowl on a pale oak worktop in a bright home kitchen on a sunny late morning. On the left, a hand with an olive-green linen sleeve rolled up tears butterhead lettuce leaves into the bowl; on the right, a South Asian woman's hand with a thin gold bangle tips halved cherry tomatoes in from a small wooden board. Beside the bowl: thick slices of cucumber, a halved lemon and a small glass jug of olive oil. Only their hands and forearms are in frame, short unpainted nails. Sun from a window on the right throws crisp shadows and makes the lettuce glisten. Vertical frame: the upper half is plain sunlit white tiled wall, the bowl and hands sit just below the centre, the oak worktop fills the bottom. 50mm lens at f/5.6.
scenes.vo: The WeightWatchers app comes included with CheqUp.
scenes.broll_brief: two women in their forties laughing while preparing a fresh salad together in a bright home kitchen
scenes.motion: The hand on the left slowly drops one more lettuce leaf into the bowl; the other hand rests on the board. The sunlight stays steady. Fixed camera.
